title: 49ers right tackle Colton McKivitz carted off in win over Vikings due to gruesome lower leg injury

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: 49ers right tackle Colton McKivitz carted off in win over Vikings due to gruesome lower leg injury
sources.description: McKivitz's left leg got pinned under multiple players at the end of a Christian McCaffrey run. When McKivitz pulled his leg from underneath the pile of players, his foot was twisted in the wrong direction.
